title: Reduced-motion pipe highlight documented as 'steady' in three places, but the code returns without drawing anything
detail: The proc returns immediately under reduced motion, yet the file header, the proc's own doc comment, and the PR body all promise a steady highlight band (E9.2 'presence, not motion').
recommended_fix: Draw a steady un-pulsed band when reduced_motion is set, or correct the header, doc comment, and PR body to state the highlight is suppressed.

title: Demo comment claims t82 reveal at scale ~0.75 / fade ~0.8; the diff's own math yields ~0.49 / ~0.41
evidence:
+#   4100 ms (t82)  — reveal mid-envelope (scale ~0.75, fade ~0.8)
+		k := f32(tick - r.spawn_tick) / f32(SPAWN_REVEAL_TICKS)
+		e := smoothstep01(k)
+		return 0.4 + 0.6 * e, 0.3 + 0.7 * e, true
detail: At t82 k=2/8=0.25, smoothstep=0.156 → scale≈0.49, fade≈0.41, not ~0.75/~0.8; those values occur near tick 84–85, the capture labeled 'reveal tail'.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to the computed values (or move the capture tick) so the audit trail matches the envelope math.

title: spawn_fx_init / spawn_fx_destroy are defined but never called anywhere in the diff
detail: The only lifecycle call wired is reset (app start_run + harness per demo); init/destroy have no callers, so the reveals buffer relies on lazy append and is never deleted.
recommended_fix: Wire init/destroy into the View lifecycle, or delete both procs and document the zero-value/append ownership.

title: Full 36-entry ring table copied inside the per-segment loop
evidence:
+	for i in 0 ..< SPAWN_RING_SEGS {
+		j := (i + 1) % SPAWN_RING_SEGS
+		table := SPAWN_RING_TABLE // local copy — a constant can't be indexed by a runtime index
+		a1 := table[i]
detail: The 288-byte table is copied once per segment — 36 copies per annulus call (two annuli per telegraph frame) — where one hoisted copy before the loop suffices.
recommended_fix: Hoist the table copy above the segment loop.
